##### Project general facts

Millennium Talia Residences is a branded residential development operated by Millennium Hotels & Resorts, offering a collection of fully furnished hotel apartments designed for contemporary living. The project combines residential comfort with hospitality-oriented services, creating a living environment focused on convenience, functionality, and modern design. The apartments feature thoughtfully planned layouts, spacious living areas, large framed windows, and integrated smart home technologies. Interiors are designed to provide a balance of comfort and practicality while reflecting a contemporary aesthetic.

Residents benefit from hotel-style services provided by Millennium Hotels & Resorts, supporting a convenient and comfortable lifestyle. The development is designed to deliver a hospitality-driven residential experience with professional management and service offerings tailored to long-term residents and investors seeking a serviced-apartment concept.

The apartments feature porcelain flooring throughout the main living areas and bathrooms, porcelain wall finishes in bathrooms, stone or artificial stone countertops, and laminate kitchen cabinetry and wardrobes. Residences are equipped with smart home technology systems. Kitchens come fully equipped with white goods, including a stove with oven, dishwasher, and refrigerator. Apartments are delivered fully furnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
